title: Legal Secretary
description:
An exciting opportunity has arisen for a Legal Secretary to join a well-established legal practice, offering a wide range of legal services to individuals and businesses alike.

As a Legal Secretary, you will provide secretarial and administrative assistance to solicitors within the Public Family team, helping to manage legal documentation, case files and client correspondence.

This is a full-time office-based role offering a salary range of £23,000 - £29,000 and benefits.

You will be responsible for:
- Providing day-to-day secretarial and administrative support to solicitors within the Public Family department.
- Audio and copy typing legal documents, reports and correspondence.
- Preparing legal documentation, including Legal Aid applications, Part 25 applications and attendance notes.
- Supporting Legal Aid billing and cost recovery activities.
- Compiling court bundles and maintaining accurate case documentation.
- Opening and updating client files in line with Lexcel, GDPR and anti-money laundering requirements.
- Handling telephone calls, correspondence, diaries, appointments and court deadlines.

What we are looking for
- Previous experience in a Legal secretarial role, or in a similar role .
- Typing speed of at least 50 words per minute, with strong document production skills.
- Good working knowledge of Microsoft Office and case management systems.
- Excellent organisational skills and attention to detail.

Shift:
- Monday - Friday: 9:00am - 5:30pm

Candidates from the following backgrounds will be considered:
- Family Legal Secretary, Family Law Secretary, Legal Secretary, Legal Administrator, Legal Assistant, Legal clerk or in a similar role.

This is a fantastic opportunity for a proactive and professional Legal Secretary to advance their career within a respected firm.

Important Information: We endeavour to process your personal data in a fair and transparent manner. In applying for this role, Additional Resources will be acting in your best interest and may contact you in relation to the role, either by email, phone or text message. For more information see our Privacy Policy on our website. It is important you are aware of your individual rights and the provisions the company has put in place to protect your data. If you would like further information on the policy or GDPR please contact us.

Additional Resources Ltd is an Employment Business and an Employment Agency as defined within The Conduct of Employment Agencies & Employment Businesses Regulations 2003.

title: Legal Secretary
company: Hello Recruitment Associates Ltd - Agency - Permanent
description:
Legal Secretary - Public Family - Solicitors - Luton up to £27000 depending on experience

Hello Recruitment is pleased to be recruiting a Legal Secretary position to work on the Public Family side of a well established firm of solicitors in Luton, Bedfordshire.

The client is looking for someone who has undertaken secretarial duties within a legal practice ot someone who can demonstrate good a administration skills that may have a legal slant to it.

You will be part of a warm and friendly team that have a community ethos about them and like to help local charities.

The salary will be between £25000 & £27000 depending on experience for this unique opportunity.

title: Legal Secretary
description:
Position: Legal Secretary, Public Family

Location: Office-based - Luton, Bedfordshire

We have an excellent opportunity for an experienced, full-time Legal Secretary to join our dedicated Public Family team. In this role, you will provide essential secretarial, administrative and client support to a busy Solicitor, playing a key part in the smooth running of the department.

Your responsibilities will include audio and copy typing legal documents and correspondence, preparing standard Public Family law documentation, including Legal Aid applications, Part 25 applications and attendance notes, and assisting with court bundles, billing and general case administration.

This is a fantastic opportunity for someone who enjoys working in a supportive, professional environment where accuracy, organisation and client care are paramount.

Key responsibilities
- Providing comprehensive secretarial and administrative support to solicitors within the Public Family department.
- Audio and copy typing legal documents, reports and correspondence.
- Preparing Public Family law documentation, including Legal Aid applications, Part 25 applications and attendance notes.
- Assisting with Legal Aid billing and cost recovery processes.
- Preparing court bundles and maintaining accurate case documentation.
- Opening and maintaining client files in accordance with Lexcel, GDPR and anti-money laundering requirements.
- Managing correspondence, telephone calls, diaries, appointments and key court deadlines.
- Liaising professionally with clients, courts and other third parties.
- Ensuring work is completed accurately, efficiently and within required timeframes.

What we offer
- A supportive and collaborative working environment.
- A competitive salary and benefits package.
- Standard office hours of 9:00am to 5:30pm, Monday to Friday.

About you
- Previous secretarial experience, preferably within a legal environment, with experience in Public Family law desirable.
- Strong typing skills, with a minimum typing speed of 50 words per minute.
- Excellent document production skills, accuracy and attention to detail.
- Experience in audio dictation typing is desirable.
- Proficiency in Microsoft Office and legal case management systems.
- Excellent communication and organisational skills.
- A friendly, professional manner and a genuine commitment to client care.

The ability to manage competing priorities and meet deadlines.

title: Private Client Paralegal
company: Clear Legal & Financial Recruitment - Agency - Permanent
description:
An established and growing law firm is seeking an experienced Private Client Paralegal to join its busy Private Client department in Bedford.

This is an excellent opportunity for a paralegal looking to further develop their career within a supportive team handling a broad range of private client matters.

The Role

You will provide support to fee earners and assist with a varied caseload including:
- Wills
- Probate and Estate Administration
- Lasting Powers of Attorney
- Trusts
- Inheritance Tax Planning

Responsibilities will include:
- Drafting legal documents and correspondence
- Preparing probate and estate administration paperwork
- Liaising with clients, beneficiaries and third parties
- Managing files and maintaining case management systems
- Assisting with the progression of matters from instruction through to completion
- Supporting fee earners with day-to-day case management

Requirements
- Previous experience within a Private Client department
- Knowledge of Wills, Probate, LPAs and Estate Administration
- Strong organisational and administrative skills
- Excellent communication and client care abilities
- Ability to manage competing priorities and work to deadlines
- Experience using case management systems would be advantageous

Benefits
- Hybrid working
- Bonus scheme
- Company pension
- Death in Service benefit
- Healthcare and wellbeing programme
- Employee discount scheme
- Ongoing training and development
- Excellent long-term career progression opportunities

Should you have any questions or wish to apply please do not hesitate to contact Clear Legal and Financial Recruitment.

Please Note: Due to the number of applications we receive we may be unable to respond to every application directly. If you have not heard from us within 3 working days, please assume your application has been unsuccessful.
